reference_spec.heading_separation_definition: signed wrap(base_Link COM XY velocity course minus each retargeted wheel rolling-plane heading)
reference_spec.wheel_heading_definition: world(local +Y wheel axle) crossed with world +Z; independent of axle spin

motion_contract.positions: world Z-up meters, link origins rather than COM
motion_contract.linear_velocities: world-frame original unmerged URDF link COM velocities, m/s
motion_contract.runtime_model_note: Export-model hashes document kinematic provenance, not an actuator/contact contract; apply and audit the shared validation model settings separately.

PPO.execution: same frozen checkpoint; independent closed-loop plant episodes

CEM.execution: same predictor/objective/search; online replanning from each plant's measured state

ppo_training_budget.scope: PPO rollout collection only, excluding setup smoke/reset checks

metric_definitions.body_beta: wrapped world-XY COM course minus projected base +X heading; may differ from body-frame reward beta under pitch/roll
metric_definitions.wheel_heading: world(local wheel +Y axle) crossed with world +Z, axial modulo 180 degrees
metric_definitions.ground_contact_gate: measured wheel ground-contact count >0 and world upward force >5 N
metric_definitions.wheel_center_offset: axial wheel-center course minus wheel rolling-plane heading, evaluated only with speed/geometry/contact eligibility
metric_definitions.contact_slip: recorded force-weighted lateral contact-slip RMS; distinct from wheel-heading geometry
metric_definitions.speed_retention: mean measured base COM XY speed divided by mean interpolated reference COM XY speed on the same native samples

audit.alignment: same world coordinates and physical time; no position or time registration

limitations: One seed-42 episode per condition; counts are descriptive and are not success probabilities.
PPO uses a PhysX-trained checkpoint; CEM uses a MuJoCo CPU predictor. Algorithm and origin are confounded, so this is not a causal physics-backend-only comparison.
CEM replans independently in each plant; paired paths are closed-loop outcomes and do not share an identical action sequence.
CEM remains an offline development controller: solve times exceed the 20 ms control period, without wall-clock action delay injected.
Equal numeric ground friction does not calibrate equivalent wheel-ground contact laws across engines.
Body beta and wheel-heading offsets are descriptive features; geometric wheel-plane angles are not measured contact-patch slip.
No PhysX-predictor MPC or MuJoCo-trained PPO reverse-origin branch is available in this replay.
